svg.text: BeliefLab | paying for information can be the best first action
Two hidden states. Exact rational policy trees and a finite-horizon envelope over every belief.
Best two-step value by first action:
Probe is optimal for b in [13/40, 27/40], with a boundary tie. Outside: exploit the more likely state.
Same two-step horizon for every root-action comparison. The myopic one-step exploit reward is zero at b=1/2.
Exact envelope, not a belief grid. Duplicate/redundant tied trees may be pruned; root-action values remain exact.
Supplied two-state finite-horizon model only, not learned sensing, infinite-horizon convergence or real-world safety.
Full exact model, all layers, selected policy trees, root values and Bayesian branch certificates are in SVG metadata.
